items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1961-01-29
items.q: I remember I was working with Sidney Desby

ctx.x: I don't remember them using any bands, you know, it might have been Sidney Fluge, or, no, I don't remember the bands that played that. Well, that's the band that, um, when Peter had the idea of this band, this original band, they used to play, he used to take dates, and, uh, he'd hire this band because at that time there was...

that old band, Pulon band was about, I believe about six pieces or so, and ten, eight and ten piece band were coming, becoming popular then. And then there was the younger musicians, you know, so I remember I was working with Sidney Desby and he had let me go for Randy Hall.

items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1979-12-05
items.q: And went on the boat with Sidney Desvene. After work with Sidney Desvene, I worked with the Redford Band

ctx.x: How long did you stay in Pensacola?

Oh, I think it was, let's see, I went there in 24, I must have came around about, no, about 20 years, about three years, about 27 years. I said, well, when the job was closed and we left Pensacola, and one stayed in Mobile, and they had a union there. They had a union in Jacksonville. We didn't have no union, black union in New Orleans. And when I was coming back, I told my daddy, this thing was really getting bad.
